To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CNTs can be dispersed efficiently using a novel dispersant Pluronic F127 and the dispersion process can be optimized to achieve maximum dispersion.
CNTs can be effectively dispersed using Pluronic F-127 in water and subsequently in cement matrix to improve the fracture behaviour of cementitious composites.
the addition of CNTs within the cementitious composites led to significant improvement in fracture energy and ductile behaviour.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of cementitious composites with high ductility and fracture resistance using CNTs as reinforcing agents.
the development of ductile cementitious composites using carbon nano tubes (CNT).
the development of ductile cementitious composites using CNTs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fracture energy and toughness of cementitious composites could be significantly enhanced using Pluronic F-127 assisted CNTs.
the present work demonstrated a novel and efficient method of dispersing CNTs in cementitious matrices using Pluronic F127 as a dispersant.
the fracture toughness and ductility of cementitious matrix was improved by 109% and by 96% using SWNTs and MWNTs, respectively, and this is mainly attributed to bridging of cracks by CNTs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of a surfactant like Pluronic F-127 is an effective method to disperse SWNTs and MWNTs in cementitious matrix to develop CNT/mortars with significantly improved mechanical performance and toughness.

the use of Pluronic surfactant as dispersant for CNTs resulted in homogeneous dispersion and distribution of CNTs within cementitious matrix, and this in turn led to significant improvement in mechanical and fracture properties of the composites.
the CNT/mortars showed significant improvement in the ductility and fracture energy as compared to plain mortars.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CNT/mortars showed significantly higher fracture energy and toughness as compared to plain mortars.

CNTs can significantly improve the fracture energy and ductile nature of the cementitious composites and can be used as a reinforcement material in concrete to enhance its durability and service life.
Pluronic F127 can be used as a dispersant for both single walled and multiwalled carbon nanotubes and can lead to significant improvement in fracture energy and toughness of cementitious composites.
